messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected for service=inference-gateway region=us-east-1
incident-bot: symptoms: p95 latency +420ms, p99 latency +1.1s, 5xx rate 3.7% (baseline 0.2%) — triggered page to #incidents and @alex_oncall
alex_oncall: on it, digging in now — grabbing dashboards 
alex_oncall: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/infra/inference-gateway?orgId=1&from=now-15m&to=now :eyes:
sre_jamie: i see a spike at 12:13 UTC, started right after a canary rollout (~12:10)
sre_jamie: stack traces in logs show repeated downstream timeouts to modelworkers: "context deadline exceeded" and 502 gateway errors
deploy-bot: deploy event: user=eng_lead_mina, job=canary-rollout, revision=release/2026-03-15-2345, started=2026-03-15T12:09:45Z, canary=20%
alex_oncall: noted. canary timed with onset. rolling rollback candidate?
eng_lead_mina: confirming: we pushed a small change to multiplexing behavior to improve throughput, but no infra changes. I can revert if we want to cut traffic
alex_oncall: immediate mitigation: shift traffic from canary to stable, enable emergency fallback routing for us-east-1. can someone run the route-shift?
sre_jamie: running the traffic switch now
sre_jamie: ```
# switch traffic to stable-variant
redwood routes update inference-gateway --region us-east-1 --set-weight canary=0 stable=100 --reason "incident 5523456789"
```
sre_jamie: applied — canary weight -> 0% :white_check_mark:
ops_logbot: config-change: routes updated by sre_jamie at 2026-03-15T12:16:02Z (request_id=abc123)
sre_jamie: enabling prefix KV cache bypass for canary keys to avoid cache thrash (temporary)
sre_jamie: ```
redwood optimize cache set --service inference-gateway --region us-east-1 --mode bypass-canary
```
alex_oncall: good. are 5xxs coming down?
alex_oncall: graphs: p99 fell from +1.1s to +300ms over last 2m but 5xx still ~1.2%
natalie_pm: @alex_oncall what’s customer impact? A few accounts reported errors in last 10m. any ETA to full recovery?
alex_oncall: preliminary: majority of requests succeeding but error tail elevated for longer-running calls. suspect change increases backend connection contention. rolling rollback of canary revision next if traffic shift doesn't normalize fully
eng_lead_mina: prepping rollback now — will coordinate with oncall
eng_lead_mina: ```
redwood deploy rollback --service inference-gateway --to-revision stable/2026-03-14-1800 --force --reason "timeout regression after canary"
```
deploy-bot: rollback job started (job_id=rb-552345-1) — estimated 60s
ops_logbot: rollback initiated by eng_lead_mina at 2026-03-15T12:18:45Z (job_id=rb-552345-1)
alex_oncall: monitoring logs and metrics during rollback
alex_oncall: logs: seeing fewer downstream timeouts now, error rate trending to 0.25%
sre_jamie: can we also annotate the traces for affected requests? toggling debug traces for 5xx sample rate to 100% for next 5m
sre_jamie: ```
telemetry set-sample --service inference-gateway --filter "status>=500" --rate 1.0 --duration 5m
```
ops_logbot: telemetry sample rate updated by sre_jamie at 2026-03-15T12:19:12Z
alex_oncall: rollback completed — deploy-bot reports success, revision stable/2026-03-14-1800 now active
deploy-bot: rollback completed successfully (job_id=rb-552345-1) — old revision restored
sre_jamie: p95/p99 are back near baseline (~+30ms/+120ms) and 5xx at baseline 0.18%
natalie_pm: thanks. I'll send a B2B note to the few affected accounts with a short explanation — will include that we rolled back a canary and service is stable
eng_lead_mina: investigating root cause: initial hypothesis: change altered connection pooling under certain request mixes, leading to contention and timeouts at scale. will open PR with revert + tests
alex_oncall: leaving a followup checklist: 1) open incident ticket 2) attach debug traces + logs 3) schedule postmortem 4) verify canary gating before reattempt
alex_oncall: creating incident ticket now — INC-2026-552345
ops_logbot: incident ticket INC-2026-552345 created by alex_oncall at 2026-03-15T12:22:01Z
eng_lead_mina: I'll own the postmortem and a safer canary gating plan
sre_jamie: thumbs to that. reassigning oncall to eng_sre rotation — @eng_lead_mina will coordinate next steps
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: service=inference-gateway region=us-east-1 status=mitigated resolved_by=rollback timestamp=2026-03-15T12:22:30Z :white_check_mark:
alex_oncall: handing off to eng_lead_mina for follow-up and RCA. ping me if anything flares up in the next hour
eng_lead_mina: will do — thanks everyone.
natalie_pm: noted for customer comms. will draft and share in #customer-success channel shortly :email:
alex_oncall: closing thread, monitoring for 30m then formal handoff to SRE queue
